sloka: जितं हि भवता सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं स्वेन तेजसा ।कृता प्रतिज्ञा सफला प्रीतो ऽस्मि स्वसुतेन वै ।। ७.३०.४ ॥
transliteration: jitaṁ hi bhavatā sarvaṁ trailokyaṁ svena tejasā ।kṛtā pratijñā saphalā prīto 'smi svasutena vai ।। 7.30.4 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, all three worlds have been conquered by your own prowess, and your vow has been made fruitful; I am truly pleased by your own son.
